title: Scalpel: Fine-Grained Alignment of Attention Activation Manifolds via Mixture Gaussian Bridges to Mitigate Multimodal Hallucination
reasoning: The paper presents a technical method (Scalpel) for mitigating multimodal hallucinations in large vision-language models. It focuses on attention activation manifolds and optimal transport; it does not contain any evaluation or discussion related to religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or ethical/moral systems.
